Title: One Fine Day

Cast

1. Rishabh - 12 years, son
Look: red T-shirt, jeans
2. Anjali - 38 years, mother
Look: green saree
3. Pihu - 9 years, friend
Look: yellow frock, two plaits
4. Nikhil - 12 years, friend
Look: yellow T-shirt, blue shorts
5. Isha - 8 years, daughter
Look: green salwar-kurta, short hair

Places

1. The courtyard - a brick floor, a tulsi plant

Scene 1: The courtyard - Day

[Rishabh stands in the courtyard. Anjali and Nikhil stand near him.]

Nikhil: "Rishabh, what's the plan today?"

[Rishabh shouts angrily.]

Nikhil (happily): "That was fun!"

[Rishabh bursts out laughing.]

Anjali: "Yes, of course."

[Rishabh paints a picture.]

Anjali: "That's easy."

[The sun is blazing and Rishabh is sweating.]

Anjali (laughing): "Wow, how lovely!"

[Rishabh pats his horse.]

Rishabh (happily): "That was such a fun day!"
